example.note: Latest available ECB reference rates (2026-10-14). ECB reference rates are published around 16:00 CET on TARGET working days. Cross rates are calculated via EUR.
example.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates
example.disclaimer: These reference rates are for information purposes only and are published free of charge by the ECB at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html. Cross rates are calculated from ECB euro rates and are not official ECB rates.

from.description: Source currency, ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD

to.description: Target currency or comma-separated list (max 30), e.g. GBP,JPY

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD within the last 90 days; non-publication days use the most recent prior ECB date
